name: Build the Future
summary:
# What is this game about?
Build the Future is an Early Access VR game. In "Phase 1" you are going to cut down trees, produce materials, and build structures in VR.

# What do you mean by saying "phase 1"?
This is an **early access game**, which means **there will be more content** coming soon.

# Tell me more about the gameplay
Your main task is building structures for future citizens. To build a structure you need to take a job in the game. Management panel will show you what materials you are going to us
